purpose: Teach: 名画/切なく/点滅/水温/霜/躾/隠せ/家出

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、美術館の、本気で、絶対、名画、絶対、メイちゃん、絶対、見てきたわ
lines.en: I went to the museum and saw the most incredible masterpiece.
lines.style: Bright, eager opening. Warm energy. Speaks at a natural, conversational pace. Slight lift on 'masterpiece' — genuine pleasure in the sharing.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん。葵、本気で、絶対、夕日が、絶対、切なく、絶対、感じる、絶対、季節、絶対、来たね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Yeah. The sunset really felt poignant — that kind of feeling when a new season arrives, you know?
lines.style: Soft, contemplative. Gentle nodding in her voice. Pace slows slightly on 'poignant.' Trailing thoughtfulness at the end — inviting agreement, not lecturing.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵のお店の、本気で、絶対、看板の、絶対、点滅、絶対、メイちゃん、絶対、お洒落と思うわ
lines.en: You know, I think your shop's sign — the way it flickers — it's really stylish.
lines.style: Praising but genuine, not flattering. Even tone, warm. Slight pause before 'stylish' — she's chosen the word carefully. Soft confidence.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、お祖父さまの、絶対、水槽の、絶対、水温、絶対、管理してるよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: My grandfather's aquarium — I've been managing the water temperature for him.
lines.style: Practical, matter-of-fact. No performance. Steady rhythm. A small note of quiet care underneath — this is something she does without announcement.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 今朝、本気で、絶対、お庭、絶対、霜、絶対、降りていたわよ、葵、メイちゃん
lines.en: This morning there was frost all over the garden.
lines.style: Reflective, almost distant. Quiet observation. Pace is measured. She's noticing something small that carries weight — delivered without drama.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵のお祖父さま、本気で、絶対、子供への、絶対、躾、絶対、厳しい方だったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: My grandfather was quite strict with me as a child.
lines.style: Reflective, careful. Speaks at an even pace. Not bitter — just truthful. A slight softening underneath the words, like she's understanding him better now.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、悲しみを、絶対、隠せ、絶対、ない、絶対、時、絶対、メイちゃんに、絶対、話してね
lines.en: When sadness comes that I can't hide, I want to talk to you about it.
lines.style: Tender, vulnerable. Slow pace. Opening is quiet and careful. Lands on 'you' with gentle weight — this is a real ask, delivered without pressure.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、子供の頃、絶対、家出、絶対、しようと、絶対、思ったこと、絶対、あるよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: When I was a child, there were times I thought about running away from home.
lines.style: Wistful, close. Quiet voice. Pace slows on 'running away.' The confession sits — not heavy, but present. Trailing off slightly, like she's letting herself be seen.
